title: Decision Dock
problem: Small product and ops decisions often get stuck in vague discussion, with no quick way to compare impact, effort, and risk.
idea: A tiny decision matrix that ranks options, surfaces the best quick win, and explains the recommended pick.
summary: Brutalist-light MVP that turns a short list of options into a ranked shortlist and a recommended choice.
notes: Static vanilla HTML/CSS/JS app with sample decision data and a bold split-screen layout.
